name: Vietnam
hook: Limestone bays and a coastline that keeps unfolding
description: North to south in one trip — Hanoi's old quarter, a night on a Ha Long Bay boat, and the Mekong Delta by smaller and smaller boats the further you go.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~16hr via one connection from the US
quickFacts.climate: Tropical, with real variation north to south

topExperiences: A night aboard a Ha Long Bay junk boat
Hanoi's old quarter by street-food crawl
The Mekong Delta by small boat
